utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what's this repair drive all about?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, it's a community event where we bring broken stuff—like my old blender—and folks help fix 'em up. Saves things from the landfill!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Have you checked if the repair drive is compatible with our version?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, Hana! The repair drive is this Saturday at 9 AM at the community center parking lot. Are you planning to come?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Wait, I thought the repair drive was next weekend, not this Saturday. Are you sure about the date and time?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, I just heard from Opal that it's this Saturday for sure.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I heard, but I'm a bit skeptical. Kira mentioned we should check the manual first for compatibility issues.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yeah, checking the manual is smart. I still doubt those drives do much more than polish the scratches.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Exactly, and even with the manual, I'm worried about the timing. When is this thing supposed to happen?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, I'm sure. It's at the community center parking lot at 9 AM Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, 9 AM Saturday at the community center parking lot. I'll be there with my toaster. Thanks, Opal!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: See you there, Dane! Don't forget to bring your toaster.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Eli, are you free this weekend for the community center repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Do you know what time it starts? I need a definite time to plan my day.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I'm still waiting to hear back about the exact time, but it's likely in the morning. I'll let you know as soon as I have a solid answer.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sam, do you happen to know who has the list of broken items for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I've got the list right here, Jules. Need me to read off any specifics?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, let me see that list.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Noah, just a friendly reminder—the repair drive's this Saturday at 9! Cleo's already got supplies sorted, so we're all set.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Wait, I thought Tess said 10? But okay, 9 works. I'll try to be there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: No worries, Noah! Even if you're a bit late, we'll be glad to have you. See you Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Leo, I'm still confused about the repair drive time. Is it 9 or 10?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It's 9 AM, Bo. Opal corrected that.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, 9 AM then? Got it, thanks Leo.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, thanks Cleo! I'll update the flyer and make sure everyone knows.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, Rosa. Let me know if you need help posting the flyers or rounding up supplies.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That's so kind of you, Cleo! I'd love your help. How about we meet at the community center tomorrow morning to put up the new flyers?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Mara! Did you hear about the repair drive this weekend? They're fixing old appliances for free!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, I'm helping organize it! We still need some basic tools like hammers and screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh great, I'll spread the word! I think my neighbor Leo has a hammer he might lend us.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Uli! So we're having a neighborhood repair drive next Saturday—bring broken stuff and we fix it together. I still don't know the exact start time though, maybe 9 or 10.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Uh, I think 10 sounds good... maybe?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, 10 might work, but I'm still waiting to hear the definite time from the organizers.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Do you know what time the repair drive starts on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I just heard from Cleo that it's actually on Sunday now, not Saturday. It's at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, thanks for the update. What time does it start on Sunday?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Ira! Did you hear about the repair drive this weekend? They're fixing old appliances for free!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I heard it's actually on Sunday at the community center. Is that what you mean?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yes, that's it! Sunday at the community center from 10 to 4. I think Sam's helping organize it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you all for your support.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Of course, Uli! I'll be there at 9 AM sharp at the community center parking lot.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That's great, Opal. I'll see you there.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Eli! I'm glad you're here. Just so you know, the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sunday at the community center, got it. But what time does it start exactly? I need a definite time to plan my day.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: It starts at 9 AM, Eli. I hope that works for you!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Mara, are you planning to come to the repair drive this Saturday? It starts at 9 AM at the community center parking lot.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, I'll be there at 9 AM. I've already gathered some hammers and screwdrivers to bring.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, thanks Mara! That'll be really helpful.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Good, let me know what Vik says.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Will do, I'll ask Vik and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Dane. I appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hi Quinn, did we ever pin down the exact time for the repair drive? I've got an old blender that needs fixing, but I can't remember when to show up.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Oren! It's this Saturday at 10 AM at the community center. Hope you can make it with that blender!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Saturday at 10, got it! I'll make sure to bring that blender. Thanks for the reminder, Quinn!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, Gus, have you heard about the repair drive? It's actually on Sunday now at the community center, not Saturday anymore.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, Rosa filled me in on that. Good thing, I would've shown up Saturday. So, what are you planning to work on? Need any tools?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I was thinking of bringing my old toaster to see if anyone can fix it. And thanks, Gus—I might take you up on that tool offer if my wrench is too rusty.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Rey, yeah I'm helping out with the repair drive this Saturday. Need a hand with anything?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hi Sam, I was wondering, do you know what time it starts on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I think we're starting around 10 AM. Are you planning to bring something?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Leo, do you know what time the repair drive starts? I heard it might be in the morning.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Starts at 9 AM, not 10.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Leo! I'll make sure to be there by 9.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Hana! So we're having a neighborhood repair drive next Saturday—bring broken stuff and we fix it together. I still don't know the exact start time though, maybe 9 or 10.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Wait, I thought the repair drive was next weekend—are we talking about this coming Saturday or the one after?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, I mean this coming Saturday—the one that's in a few days. Still not sure if it's 9 or 10 though.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Honestly, I don't know much about it. I just showed up.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure this repair drive isn't just another waste of time? I've seen too many of these fizzle out.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I'm not sure, Kira. I probably missed the finer points again.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I'm not sure who has the list. Maybe try asking Ira?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Good idea, I'll ask Ira. Thanks, Mina!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: You're welcome. Let me know if you need any help with the drive.
